paragraphs: My name is **Oswaldo Osuna** and I am an **AI Engineer**. I have been working in the tech industry for over **6 years**. I am passionate about building effective software and learning every day to grow professionally in a dynamic environment.

At **ARCOS LLC**, I delivered **the company's MCP platform on a scalable architecture** while also introducing agentic coding workflows that significantly accelerated delivery and raised the quality bar across the team. Prior to that, I led full stack development for **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in the Log Analytics service**.
I have also developed solutions for the **aerospace industry** , building web applications for **managing critical business processes**.
